record: IRPT_ANLREQ FWD-1 run: cross-library check of the minted login hash (closes the gap named in 0.9.0_WK_IRPT_ANLREQ~149 FWD1_DRIVER_RECORD.json 'bcryptjs=ABSENT' and ~148 FWD1_LOGIN_DRIVER_READ.json 'Cross-library compatibility is not exercised by this read')

claim_words.MEASURED: this seat ran it in this session, in an empty scratch directory outside the repository
claim_words.NOT_READ: the bcryptjs version the portal auth handler actually ships (its package.json and node_modules are absent on this box); the two major versions below bracket the question

method: Python bcrypt 5.0.0 hashed a random throwaway string at cost 12 (the same call as fwd1_mint.py: bcrypt.hashpw(raw, bcrypt.gensalt(12))); the hash and the string travelled only by environment variables between the two processes and were never printed, written or logged; node v24.19.0 ran compareSync from bcryptjs 2.4.3 and bcryptjs 3.0.2 (installed with npm into the scratch directory) on the right string and on the string with one character appended.
reads_as: A hash written the way fwd1_mint.py writes it verifies under both bcryptjs major versions and refuses a wrong password, so the login side's compare (password.ts:25-26, bcryptjs) is not expected to refuse the minted row on the hash alone.
does_not_show: that the live auth handler's own bcryptjs version behaves the same (NOT_READ above); that the minted row passes the handler's other conditions (status, role, origin gate), which AR-y-344 read from source and the run's R0 reads re-check; any live login.
removal: the scratch directory sits under this session's scratchpad and holds no secret; no repository file other than this record was written.
